description:
Configure the facility profile settings in Jolly Lobby Track. Navigate to the system options or configuration area and update the Company/Organization profile with the following details:

- Company Name: Greenfield Medical Center
- Address: 450 Healthcare Drive
- Suite: Suite 200
- City: Portland
- State: OR
- Zip: 97201
- Phone: (503) 555-0142

Save the settings. Verify that the new company name 'Greenfield Medical Center' appears on the main application window title or header.
